scenarios.theme: The last unit can be bought twice. Which store and write boundary will you choose?
scenarios.assumptions: A marketplace has two concurrent buyers, changing product attributes and a strict no-oversell requirement. The team proposes a document database because product fields vary. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.
